class.name: IfcTaskTimeRecurring
class.brief_description: IfcTaskTimeRecurring is a recurring instance of IfcTaskTime for handling regularly scheduled or repetitive tasks. HISTORY: New entity in IFC2x4.
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.
